about: Questions an administrator would ask, with the console page whose guide section must answer them (route), and questions the guide must NOT answer (outOfScope). run-help-eval.ts measures retrieval against them with the real embedding model and suggests AO_HELP_MIN_SCORE.

inScope.q: How do I create a coupon?
Where can I see which users signed up this week?
How do I disable someone's account?
How do I sign a user out of all their devices?
How do I give someone free credits?
Where do I change a plan's price?
How do I settle a payment that is pending?
How do I switch a feature off for everyone?
Where do I see which servers are up or down?
Where is the audit log of what admins did?
How do I approve a new administrator?
How do I publish a marketplace listing?
Why is my skill upload refused with 503?
How do I start a promotion campaign?
How do I send an announcement by email?
How do I reply to a support ticket?
What can the finance role do?
Which numbers show how reliable the agent runs are?

outOfScope: What is the airspeed velocity of an unladen swallow?
Write me a poem about autumn.
